label: Navigation
description: Directions, destinations, and simple street-language for moving around town.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Finding a destination. 1. 'Где находится' is the standard way to ask where something is located. 2. 'Метро' is a high-value city survival word. 3. This is one of the most practical travel sentences you can learn.

Strategic focus: Asking for directions. 1. 'Как пройти' is the basic phrase for getting walking directions. 2. 'К станции' gives the target destination clearly. 3. This line is useful with trains, subways, and neighborhood navigation.

Strategic focus: Directional instruction. 1. 'Идите прямо' gives the simplest possible route command. 2. 'До светофора' adds a concrete landmark. 3. This is the kind of phrase you will hear again and again when asking for help.

Strategic focus: Route sequencing. 1. 'Потом' marks the next step in the route. 2. 'Поверните налево' is a core direction phrase for navigation. 3. This sentence teaches the shape of step-by-step route instructions.

Strategic focus: Distance check. 1. 'Это далеко' asks about distance in a very natural way. 2. 'Отсюда' anchors the question to the current place. 3. This is a useful sentence whenever you need to judge whether walking is realistic.
